name: Attention Unparalleled
source:
Following the events of Patchwork Ego where Emma made a pact with an eldritch creature, she wakes up in an unfamiliar bed. While she's been honing her new powers as a warlock with Artur's help, she's not prepared for the eldritch madness that ensues when her entire world is turned upside down and nothing is as she remembers it to be.


And then there's Stanley, whom she's never heard of, but who somehow dominates the entire media landscape.

[From [url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/attention-unparalleled]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Patchwork Ego》中與異界生物締結契約後，艾瑪在一張陌生的床上醒來。雖說這段時間她一直在阿圖爾幫助下磨鍊自己作為契約術士獲得的新力量，可當整個世界天翻地覆，一切都和記憶中不同，她還是全然沒有準備好面對接踵而來的詭異與瘋狂。

還有個叫斯坦利的人。她根本沒聽說過他，可不知為什麼，到處都是他的新聞。

［摘自[url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/attention-unparalleled]itch.io[/url]］
